fact: The National Electronic Authentication Authority manages the platform, can suspend or terminate the service for cyber security or maintenance, and takes monitoring and enforcement action.
All rights in the application, platform, software and source code belong to the competent authority and/or its licensed entities.

The police spokesman says the civil fingerprint system that runs new national numbers and the national card belongs to Dermalog, with state licences, and Germans must operate it; the police director general went to Germany to seek a restart, so no new numbers are issued.
The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority says SUDAPASS is developed and operated by qualified Sudanese professionals.
